statement: Hon Hai's cloud and networking division kept growing strongly and had already passed 50 percent of total company revenue for the first time in the second quarter of 2026.
why: The revenue mix shift shows AI infrastructure has become the majority of Foxconn's business, which makes the whole company's results a proxy for data-center spending rather than consumer electronics.

impact.mechanism: A rising AI share of contract-manufacturing revenue signals that data-center orders, not handsets, are setting the production schedule, supporting accelerator demand.

evidence.excerpt: enjoyed significant year-on-year revenue growth amid accelerating AI momentum

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the mix figure is qualitative in this document, so no measured value is claimed.
